english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for actively allowing or indulging wrongdoing, and it can also mean overlooking it.
Use this when enabling means tolerating or encouraging someone’s harmful or bad behaviour rather than simply making something possible.

examples.english: We must not condone employees deceiving customers.
examples.traditional: 我哋唔可以縱容員工呃客。

examples.english: They enable their son to keep bullying people.
